headline: Congress would bar federal benefits for farmland data centers
text:
Here is how your fear of AI is being used to centralize power today.

Congress would bar federal financial benefit for the construction, expansion, or substantial rehabilitation of data centers on prime farmland and other certain farmland. Not passed.

104 measures in 30 jurisdictions would pause data centers, or add conditions on building and running them.

65 measures in 20 jurisdictions cite the fear that data centers are taking the power and the water.

2,071 measures tracked. 401 carry a control, and they would hand new power to 88 offices.
